heading.en: Making room for a new partner

hook.en: A and B run a firm in Hubballi. C joins for a one-fifth share. That fifth must come out of A's and B's shares — but how much from each?
hook.kn: ಹುಬ್ಬಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ A ಮತ್ತು B ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. C ಐದನೇ ಒಂದು ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಪಾಲು A ಮತ್ತು B ಯಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟೆಷ್ಟು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: List the adjustments needed on admission
Calculate the new profit sharing ratio

narration.en: A and B run a firm in Hubballi. C joins for a one-fifth share. That fifth must come out of A's and B's shares — but how much from each? Admission is a reconstitution of the firm, and it starts with new and sacrificing ratios.
narration.kn: ಹುಬ್ಬಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ A ಮತ್ತು B ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. C ಐದನೇ ಒಂದು ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆ ಪಾಲು A ಮತ್ತು B ಯಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟೆಷ್ಟು ಬರುತ್ತದೆ? ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಪುನರ್ರಚನೆ; ಇದು ಹೊಸ ಮತ್ತು ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳಿಂದ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: Admission and the adjustments it needs

body.en: A new partner gets two rights: a share in the assets and a share in future profits. In return he brings capital, and usually a premium for goodwill. On admission we adjust: the new profit sharing ratio, the sacrificing ratio, goodwill, revaluation of assets and liabilities, accumulated profits and losses, and (if agreed) partners' capitals.
body.kn: ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನಿಗೆ ಆಸ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಲು ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅವನು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಸುನಾಮದ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ತರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಹೊಸ ಅನುಪಾತ, ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಅನುಪಾತ, ಸುನಾಮ, ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ, ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭ ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳಗಳ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು.

title.en: On the board: New and sacrificing ratio

narration.en: Draw the old profit as one bar: A has three-fifths, B two-fifths.

say.en: Draw the old profit as one bar: A has three-fifths, B two-fifths.
C takes one-fifth, half from A and half from B: one-tenth from each.
So the new ratio is five to three to two.
Sacrificing ratio is old minus new: one-tenth each, so one to one.

body.en: Each old partner gives up part of his share. Sacrificing ratio = old ratio − new ratio. If nothing is said about how the new partner acquires his share, old partners sacrifice in their old ratio, so the sacrificing ratio equals the old ratio.
body.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ತಮ್ಮ ಪಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಅನುಪಾತ = ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತ − ಹೊಸ ಅನುಪಾತ. ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ತ್ಯಾಗದ ಅನುಪಾತ = ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತ.

title.en: Try it: new profit sharing ratio

caption.en: A and B share 3:2. Choose C's share and how much of it comes from A (the rest from B). The pie shows the new shares.

narration.en: Whatever C gets, A and B give up between them; the sacrificing ratio shows who gave how much.

label.en: Part of C's share given by A

tryThis.en: Set k = 0.6: C takes his share in the old ratio. Is the new A : B still 3 : 2?
Can B's sacrifice ever exceed his old share? Try it.

problem.en: A and B share profits 3:2. C is admitted for a 1/5 share, which he acquires equally from A and B. Find the new ratio and the sacrificing ratio.

steps.en: C takes 1/5 equally: 1/10 from A and 1/10 from B.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A and B share profits 3:2. C is admitted for a 1/5 share, which he acquires equally from A and B. Find the new ratio and the sacrificing ratio.

body.en: When the new partner's share comes from old partners in their old ratio, each old partner's new share is old share × (1 − new partner's share). For 3:2 and a 1/4 newcomer: 3/5 × 3/4 = 9/20 and 2/5 × 3/4 = 6/20, so 9:6:5.

narration.en: Old ratio × (1 − new share). When the new partner's share comes from old partners in their old ratio, each old partner's new share is old share × (1 − new partner's share). For 3:2 and a 1/4 newcomer: 3/5 × 3/4 = 9/20 and 2/5 × 3/4 = 6/20, so 9:6:5.

homework.en: A, B share 5:3. C is admitted for 1/4 share taken 3/16 from A and 1/16 from B. Find the new ratio.

narration.en: Recap. Admission needs adjustments for ratio, goodwill, revaluation, reserves and capitals. Sacrificing ratio = old ratio − new ratio. If not stated, old partners sacrifice in their old ratio.
